## Load Data/Txi object

```{r}
# READING ALL SUBFOLDERS AND CREATING METADATA

setwd("/Users/soniarodriguez/Documents/SANGER/RESULTS/Phenserine/Bulk_RNA_seq/Raw_data")

all_folders <- list.dirs("salmon_quant", recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)

sampleinfo <- data.frame(
  ID = all_folders,
  Batch = sub("^([^_]+)_.*$", "\\1", all_folders),
  Day = ifelse(
    grepl("_[Dd][0-9]+_", all_folders),
    sub("^.*_([Dd][0-9]+)_.*$", "\\1", all_folders),
    "D20"
  ),
  Treatment = sub("^.*_(C|P|S|SP)[0-9]*$", "\\1", all_folders),
  Replicate = ifelse(
    grepl("[0-9]+$", all_folders),
    sub("^.*?([0-9]+)$", "\\1", all_folders),
    NA
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

files <- file.path("salmon_quant", sampleinfo$ID, "quant.sf")
names(files) <- sampleinfo$ID

stopifnot(all(file.exists(files)))

qc_check_salmon_strict <- function(file) {

  ok <- TRUE
  msg <- character()

  # 1. file size sanity
  info <- file.info(file)
  if (is.na(info$size) || info$size < 1e5) {
    ok <- FALSE
    msg <- c(msg, "file too small/suspicious")
  }

  # 2. detect NUL bytes properly (THIS was missing)
  raw <- readBin(file, "raw", n = info$size)
  if (any(raw == as.raw(0))) {
    ok <- FALSE
    msg <- c(msg, "embedded NUL bytes")
  }

  # 3. safe header parse
  header <- tryCatch(
    readLines(file, n = 1, warn = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(header)) {
    ok <- FALSE
    msg <- c(msg, "unreadable header")
  }

  # 4. column count check
  if (!is.null(header)) {
    cols <- strsplit(header, "\t", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(cols) != 5) {
      ok <- FALSE
      msg <- c(msg, paste0("bad column count: ", length(cols)))
    }
  }

  # 5. transcript count sanity (THIS catches your failures)
  nlines <- tryCatch(
    length(readLines(file, warn = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) NA
  )

  if (!is.na(nlines)) {
    if (nlines < 50000) {
      ok <- FALSE
      msg <- c(msg, paste0("too few rows: ", nlines))
    }
  }

  data.frame(
    file = file,
    ok = ok,
    message = paste(msg, collapse = "; ")
  )
}

qc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, qc_check_salmon_strict))

good_samples <- qc$file[qc$ok]
bad_samples  <- qc$file[!qc$ok]

good_samples
bad_samples

library(tximport)

tximport_safe <- function(files, tx2gene, ...) {

  # keep only good files
  qc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, qc_check_salmon_strict))
  files_ok <- files[qc$ok]

  message("Using ", length(files_ok), " / ", length(files), " samples")

  txi <- tximport(
    files_ok,
    type = "salmon",
    txIn = TRUE,
    txOut = FALSE,
    tx2gene = tx2gene,
    ignoreTxVersion = TRUE
  )

  return(list(
    txi = txi,
    qc = qc
  ))
}

res <- tximport_safe(files, tx2gene)

txi <- res$txi
qc  <- res$qc

qc

names(txi)

```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Convert metadata to factors
sampleinfo$Batch      <- factor(sampleinfo$Batch)
sampleinfo$Day        <- factor(sampleinfo$Day)
sampleinfo$Treatment  <- factor(sampleinfo$Treatment)
sampleinfo$Replicate  <- factor(sampleinfo$Replicate)

# Look at your design variables
summary(sampleinfo)

# Check colinearity (design matrix structure)
lm_check <- lm(
  1:nrow(sampleinfo) ~ Batch + Day + Treatment + Replicate,
  data = sampleinfo
)

# Check which coefficients are linearly dependent
alias(lm_check)
```

```{r}

############################################################
# COMBINATION TREATMENT - FILTER SAMPLES (HT37 + HT39B and HT39C only)
############################################################

keep <- grepl("^HT37|^HT39", sampleinfo$ID)

sampleinfo_syn <- sampleinfo[keep, ]
dds_syn <- ddsTxi[, keep]

############################################################
# 1. FACTORS
############################################################

sampleinfo_syn$Batch <- factor(sub("_.*", "", sampleinfo_syn$ID))

sampleinfo_syn$P <- factor(
  ifelse(sampleinfo_syn$Treatment %in% c("P","SP"), "Yes", "No"),
  levels = c("No","Yes")
)

sampleinfo_syn$S <- factor(
  ifelse(sampleinfo_syn$Treatment %in% c("S","SP"), "Yes", "No"),
  levels = c("No","Yes")
)

colData(dds_syn) <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(sampleinfo_syn)

############################################################
# 2. MODEL
############################################################

design(dds_syn) <- ~ Batch + P + S + P:S
dds_syn <- DESeq(dds_syn)

resultsNames(dds_syn)

############################################################
# 3. MAIN EFFECTS
############################################################

res_P <- results(dds_syn, name = "P_Yes_vs_No")
res_S <- results(dds_syn, name = "S_Yes_vs_No")
res_int <- results(dds_syn, name = "PYes.SYes")
res_PS <- results(
  dds_syn,
  contrast = list(c("P_Yes_vs_No", "S_Yes_vs_No", "PYes.SYes"))
)

############################################################
# 5. ADD GENE SYMBOLS
############################################################

add_symbol <- function(res, dds) {
  res$gene_symbol <- rowData(dds)$gene_symbol[
    match(rownames(res), rownames(dds))
  ]
  res
}

res_P   <- add_symbol(res_P, dds_syn)
res_S   <- add_symbol(res_S, dds_syn)
res_int <- add_symbol(res_int, dds_syn)
res_PS  <- add_symbol(res_PS, dds_syn)

############################################################
# 6. SIGNIFICANCE TABLES
############################################################

sig_P   <- subset(res_P,   padj < 0.05 & !is.na(padj))
sig_S   <- subset(res_S,   padj < 0.05 & !is.na(padj))
sig_int <- subset(res_int, padj < 0.05 & !is.na(padj))
sig_PS   <- subset(res_PS,   padj < 0.05 & !is.na(padj))

############################################################
# 7. COMBINED MASTER TABLE
############################################################

all_res <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(dds_syn),

  log2FC_P   = res_P$log2FoldChange,
  log2FC_S   = res_S$log2FoldChange,
  log2FC_INT = res_int$log2FoldChange,
  log2FC_PS  = res_PS$log2FoldChange,

  padj_P   = res_P$padj,
  padj_S   = res_S$padj,
  padj_INT = res_int$padj,
  padj_PS  = res_PS$padj,

  symbol = rowData(dds_syn)$gene_symbol
)


############################################################
# 8. CLASSIFICATION (BIOLOGICAL MECHANISM)
############################################################

all_res$class <- NA_character_

# single effects
all_res$class[
  all_res$padj_P < 0.05 & all_res$padj_S >= 0.05 & all_res$padj_INT >= 0.05
] <- "P_only"

all_res$class[
  all_res$padj_S < 0.05 & all_res$padj_P >= 0.05 & all_res$padj_INT >= 0.05
] <- "S_only"

# double effects
all_res$class[
  all_res$padj_PS < 0.05 & all_res$padj_P >= 0.05 & all_res$padj_S >= 0.05 & all_res$padj_INT >= 0.05
] <- "PS_only"

# additive (higher than combination)
all_res$class[
  all_res$padj_PS < 0.05  & all_res$log2FC_INT >= abs(0.3) & sign(all_res$log2FC_PS) == sign(all_res$log2FC_INT)
] <- "additive"

# interaction = synergy / antagonism
all_res$class[
  all_res$padj_INT < 0.05
] <- "non_additive (interaction)"

############################################################
# 10. EXPORT
############################################################

write.csv(all_res, "DEG_results/full_mechanism_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(res_P, "DEG_results/DEG_Phenserine.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(res_S, "DEG_results/DEG_Sacubitril.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(res_PS, "DEG_results/DEG_Sacubitril_Phenserine.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(res_int, "DEG_results/DEG_interaction_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
#######################################
# GENE SET ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS - FGSEA
#######################################

dir.create("FGSEA", showWarnings = FALSE)

my_FGSEA <- function(mypath, organism = c("HUMAN", "MOUSE", "RAT"),
                     database = c("GO", "KEGG", "REACTOME"),
                     myresultspath) {
  library(tibble)
  library(fgsea)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(KEGGREST)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
  library(org.Rn.eg.db)
  library(dplyr)
  
  # Select species
  msig_species <- switch(organism,
                         "HUMAN" = "Homo sapiens",
                         "MOUSE" = "Mus musculus",
                         "RAT"   = "Rattus norvegicus")
  
  # For KEGGREST, map to KEGG organism codes
  kegg_code <- switch(organism,
                      "HUMAN" = "hsa",
                      "MOUSE" = "mmu",
                      "RAT"   = "rno")
  
  # Pick OrgDb for symbol → Entrez mapping
  OrgDb <- switch(organism,
                  "HUMAN" = org.Hs.eg.db,
                  "MOUSE" = org.Mm.eg.db,
                  "RAT"   = org.Rn.eg.db)
  
  # Get gene sets
  if (database == "GO") {
    gs <- msigdbr(species = msig_species, collection = "C5", subcollection = "GO:BP")
    pathway_list <- gs %>%
      dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
      group_by(gs_name) %>%
      summarise(genes = list(gene_symbol), .groups = "drop") %>%
      deframe()
    
  } else if (database == "REACTOME") {
    gs <- msigdbr(species = msig_species, collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:REACTOME")
    pathway_list <- gs %>%
      dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
      group_by(gs_name) %>%
      summarise(genes = list(gene_symbol), .groups = "drop") %>%
      deframe()
    
  } else if (database == "KEGG") {
    message("Fetching dynamic KEGG pathways via KEGGREST...")
    pathways <- keggList("pathway", kegg_code)
    pathway_ids <- names(pathways)
    
    pathway_list <- lapply(pathway_ids, function(pid) {
      genes <- keggGet(pid)[[1]]$GENE
      if (!is.null(genes)) {
        # KEGG returns: c("geneid1","desc1","geneid2","desc2",...)
        entrez_ids <- genes[seq(1, length(genes), 2)]
        return(entrez_ids)
      } else {
        return(NULL)
      }
    })
    names(pathway_list) <- pathways
  }
  
  #  Get list of DEG files
  file.names <- dir(mypath, pattern = "DEG_")[!grepl("sig", dir(mypath, pattern = "DEG_"), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  
  for (i in seq_along(file.names)) {
    message("Processing file: ", file.names[i])
    res <- read.table(file = file.path(mypath, file.names[i]), header = TRUE, sep = ",")
    
    if (!"gene_symbol" %in% colnames(res)) {
      stop("Column 'gene_symbol' not found in ", file.names[i])
    }
    
    # Select ranking column
    if ("stat" %in% colnames(res)) {
      res$rank_stat <- res$stat
    } else if ("log2FoldChange_shrunk" %in% colnames(res)) {
      res$rank_stat <- res$log2FoldChange_shrunk
    } else if ("log2FoldChange" %in% colnames(res)) {
      res$rank_stat <- res$log2FoldChange
    } else {
      stop("No ranking column found.")
    }
    
    # Prepare ranks
    ranks_df <- res %>%
      filter(!is.na(gene_symbol)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(rank_stat)) %>%
      distinct(gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      arrange(desc(rank_stat))
    
    ranks <- ranks_df$rank_stat
    names(ranks) <- ranks_df$gene_symbol
    
    # If KEGG → convert to Entrez IDs
    if (database == "KEGG") {
      idmap <- AnnotationDbi::select(OrgDb,
                                     keys = names(ranks),
                                     columns = c("ENTREZID"),
                                     keytype = "SYMBOL")
      idmap <- idmap[!is.na(idmap$ENTREZID), ]
      
      ranks <- ranks[idmap$SYMBOL]
      names(ranks) <- idmap$ENTREZID
    }
    
    # Run fgsea
    fgsea_res <- fgsea(pathways = pathway_list,
                       stats = ranks,
                       minSize = 15,
                       maxSize = 500)
    
    # Save results
    out_file <- file.path(myresultspath,
                          paste0(sub("DEG_", "", file.names[i]), "_FGSEA_", database, ".csv"))
    
    fgsea_res_to_save <- fgsea_res %>%
      mutate(leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";")))
    
    write.csv(fgsea_res_to_save, out_file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Saved FGSEA results to: ", out_file)
  }
  
  message("FGSEA analysis complete for all files in folder: ", myresultspath)
}
```

```{r}
#######################################
#  TF Activities (updated to collecTRI)
#######################################

library(viper)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(biomaRt)
library(tidyr)
library(OmnipathR)
library(decoupleR)

# Main TF activity function

my_TFA <- function(mypath, organism = c("human", "mouse", "rat")) {
  organism <- match.arg(organism)
  outfolder <- file.path(getwd(), "TF_Activities")
  dir.create(outfolder, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
 
Regulon_file <- get_collectri(
  organism = organism,
  split_complexes = FALSE

)
  df2regulon_simple <- function(df) {
  
  stopifnot(all(c("source", "target", "mor") %in% colnames(df)))
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(source), !is.na(target), !is.na(mor)) %>%
    filter(mor %in% c(-1, 1)) %>%
    distinct(source, target, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  split(df, df$source) %>%
    purrr::map(function(dat) {
      list(
        tfmode = setNames(dat$mor, dat$target),
        likelihood = setNames(rep(1, nrow(dat)), dat$target)
      )
    })
}

    regulon_list <- df2regulon_simple(Regulon_file)
  
  file.names <- dir(mypath, pattern = "DEG_")[!grepl("sig", dir(mypath, pattern = "DEG_"), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  
  for (i in seq_along(file.names)) {
    message("Processing file: ", file.names[i])
    
    DEsignature <- read.table(file = file.path(mypath, file.names[i]), header = TRUE, sep = ",")
    
    if (!"gene_symbol" %in% colnames(DEsignature)) {
      stop("Column 'gene_symbol' not found in ", file.names[i])
    }
    
    DEsignature <- DEsignature %>%
      filter(!is.na(gene_symbol) & gene_symbol != "") %>%
      distinct(gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    if (!("padj" %in% colnames(DEsignature) && "stat" %in% colnames(DEsignature))) {
      stop("Columns 'padj' and/or 'stat' not found in ", file.names[i])
    }
    
    myStatistics <- matrix(DEsignature$stat,
                           dimnames = list(DEsignature$gene_symbol, 'stat'))
    myPvalue <- matrix(DEsignature$padj,
                       dimnames = list(DEsignature$gene_symbol, 'padj'))
    
   
    mySignature <- DEsignature$stat
    names(mySignature) <- DEsignature$gene_symbol
    mySignature <- sort(mySignature, decreasing = TRUE)

    
    # Estimate TF activities using regulon
  
    mrs <- msviper(ges = mySignature, regulon = regulon_list, ges.filter = FALSE, minsize = 5)
    
    TF_activities <- data.frame(
      Regulon = names(mrs$es$nes),
      Size = mrs$es$size[names(mrs$es$nes)],
      NES = mrs$es$nes,
      p.value = mrs$es$p.value,
      FDR = p.adjust(mrs$es$p.value, method = 'fdr')
    )
    
    TF_activities <- TF_activities[order(TF_activities$p.value), ]
    
    out_file <- file.path(outfolder, paste0(file.names[i], "_TFAs", ".csv"))
    write.csv(TF_activities, file = out_file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Saved TF activity results to: ", out_file)
  }
  
  message("TF activity analysis complete for all files in: ", outfolder)
}
```

```{r}

## Plot TF ACTIVITY ##

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

plot_TFA_bubbles <- function(mypath, top_n = 20, use_fdr = FALSE) {
  
  outfolder <- file.path(getwd(), "TFA_BubblePlots")
  dir.create(outfolder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  file.names <- list.files(
    mypath,
    pattern = "TFAs.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  for (f in file.names) {
    
    message("Processing: ", basename(f))
    
    df <- readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    stopifnot(all(c("Regulon", "NES") %in% colnames(df)))
    
    sig_col <- if (use_fdr && "FDR" %in% colnames(df)) {
      "FDR"
    } else if ("p.value" %in% colnames(df)) {
      "p.value"
    } else if ("FDR" %in% colnames(df)) {
      "FDR"
    } else {
      stop("No 'p.value' or 'FDR' column found in ", basename(f))
    }
    
    df2 <- df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(Regulon), !is.na(NES), !is.na(.data[[sig_col]])) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        sig_value = pmax(.data[[sig_col]], 1e-300),   # avoid -Inf
        log_sig = -log10(sig_value)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(sig_value, dplyr::desc(abs(NES))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Regulon = forcats::fct_reorder(Regulon, NES)
      )
    
    p <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = NES, y = Regulon)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
      geom_point(aes(size = log_sig, colour = NES), alpha = 0.85) +
      scale_colour_gradient2(
        low = "navy",    # blue
        mid = "white",
        high = "maroon",   # red
        midpoint = 0,
        name = "NES"
      ) +
      scale_size_continuous(name = paste0("-log10(", sig_col, ")")) +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Top ", top_n, " TF activities: ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))),
        x = "NES",
        y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
    out_pdf <- file.path(
      outfolder,
      paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)), "_bubbleplot_top", top_n, ".pdf")
    )
    
    out_png <- file.path(
      outfolder,
      paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)), "_bubbleplot_top", top_n, ".png")
    )
    
    ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = 4, height = 6)
    ggsave(out_png, p, width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  message("Done. Bubble plots saved in: ", outfolder)
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)

outfolder <- file.path(getwd(), "Synergy")
dir.create(outfolder, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# Load TFA results from files
# -----------------------------
TFA_dir <- "TF_Activities"

TFA_files <- list.files(
  TFA_dir,
  pattern = "(Sacubitril.csv_TFAs|Phenserine.csv_TFAs)\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(TFA_files) == 0) stop("No TFA results found in TF_Activities folder!")

# Use filenames (without extension) as comparison names
comparison_names <- basename(TFA_files) %>% str_remove(".csv_TFAs\\.csv$")

# Read files with proper names as source_file
TFA_all_df <- map2_dfr(
  TFA_files,
  comparison_names,
  ~ read_csv(.x) %>% mutate(source_file = .y)
)

# -----------------------------
# Identify significant TFs across all comparisons
# -----------------------------
sig_TFs <- TFA_all_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(FDR), FDR < 0.05) %>%
  distinct(Regulon) %>%
  pull(Regulon)

message("Number of TFs significant in at least one comparison: ", length(sig_TFs))

if (length(sig_TFs) == 0) stop("No significant TFs to plot!")

# -----------------------------
# Build NES matrix including all TFs across comparisons
# -----------------------------
heatmap_mat <- TFA_all_df %>%
  filter(Regulon %in% sig_TFs) %>%
  dplyr::select(Regulon, source_file, NES) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source_file, values_from = NES)

# Convert to matrix with rownames = TFs
heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat %>%
  column_to_rownames("Regulon") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Replace NAs with 0 so clustering works
heatmap_mat[is.na(heatmap_mat)] <- 0

# -----------------------------
# Plot heatmap
# -----------------------------
pheatmap_syn <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue3", "white", "red4"))(50),
  clustering_method = "complete",
  fontsize_row = 10,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  main = "NES heatmap of significant TFs"
)



ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    "~/Documents/SANGER/RESULTS/Phenserine/Bulk_RNA_seq/Analysis/Synergy",
    "Heatmap_TFAs_Synergy.pdf"
  ),
  plot = pheatmap_syn$gtable,
  width = 3,
  height = 10
)
```
